# Public signed DCAP vectors

Copied unchanged from Automata DCAP commit
`5962363a6cce70fa6da70bb412e0a9ababe97d95`,
[`evm/forge-test/assets/v2/fixtures`](https://github.com/automata-network/automata-dcap-attestation/tree/5962363a6cce70fa6da70bb412e0a9ababe97d95/evm/forge-test/assets/v2/fixtures).
The upstream provenance documents the Intel collateral and public quotes.
These are historical signed test inputs, not current launch attestations.
No private keys, production evidence, generated proofs or local results are included.
The Alibaba V5 vector must fail strict verification (migration service TD).
The other two authenticate at their recorded times, but do not bind a shim launch.
The Google V5 quote originated under Apache-2.0 at
https://github.com/google/go-tdx-guest/blob/48f3644ca143b4800def5f89dca819294606bf4e/testing/testdata/quote_sample_v5.dat.
